blog.aboutContent:
Hi, I’m Edwin Pedraza, a Business Analytics & Workflow Specialist with a background in systems engineering and IT support. Currently, I work at Converse Advisory Group (Sunshine Coast, Australia), where I focus on building data models, dashboards, and automated workflows that make reporting faster and smarter. What I do Data Analytics: Power BI, Excel Power Query, DAX, and advanced reporting.


 Automation: Streamlining finance and business processes using VBA and Power Automate. Development: Experience with Python, React, Supabase, and WordPress for both internal tools and personal projects.

Documentation & Governance: Building SOPs, KPI catalogs, and process manuals to ensure analytics work is scalable and repeatable. What you’ll find here This blog is where I share: 

 Tutorials and walkthroughs on Power BI, 

Excel, and automation. Insights on data workflows, reporting strategy, and process design. 

Personal projects like portfolio sites, mobile apps, and learning experiments. Why I write I believe analytics should be practical and usable—not just numbers on a page. My goal is to document solutions, share lessons learned, and help others save time by reusing tested approaches.
